name: landguard
description: LandGuard Kenya — one-command orchestrator for the full stack (backend + frontend + ML service)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,ML -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "python ml-service/app.py"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.prod: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,ML -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start" "python ml-service/app.py"
scripts.fast: npm run build && npm run prod
